messages:
ellie-ux: Quick accessibility thread: Streaming response panel (Chat -> Conversation view) is noisy for screen reader users. When we stream tokens into the transcript, SRs announce every chunk and it floods NVDA/VoiceOver. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/stream-noise.png sam_k: Yeah noticed that too. Happens most on longer completions where tokens come 20-50ms. frank-sre: From infra side, we stream small payloads often for latency. We can't batch them too much for UX reasons. But we can change how SRs are notified. toni-qa: Repro steps: Open convo with long answer, enable VoiceOver, focus panel, watch SR read continuously until the stream ends. Problem: user can't navigate mid-stream. access-bot: a11y-scan: MEDIUM: live region updates too frequent (aria-live="polite"/assertive used on every chunk). HIGH: no Pause/Stop control exposed to keyboard/SR. LOW: focus outline on streaming action button is low contrast in dark theme. ellie-ux: Proposed pattern: decouple visual streaming from SR announcements. Keep streaming for sighted users, but for SR users append updates to an offscreen buffer and announce higher-level statuses only (e.g., "New streaming response started", "Response paused", "Response complete"). Also provide Pause/Resume controls with aria-pressed. sam_k: Implementation sketch: ```
...tokens appended normally...
Response started
``` On token arrival: append to visual-output. For SR: only update #sr-stream-status at start/pause/finish. Keep sr-buffer hidden from SR (aria-hidden) so it doesn't get re-read repeatedly. frank-sre: Good approach. Need to make sure aria-pressed toggles correctly and keyboard users can tab to the Pause button. Also when paused, Pause should become "Resume" and announce "Response paused" in the polite live region. toni-qa: Tests: VoiceOver should hear exactly three announcements: start, paused/resumed (optional), and finished. Also check that while streaming, keyboard focus on the transcript is stable and doesn't jump with new content. ellie-ux: Also UX nit: when paused, visually show a subtle overlay with a clear affordance to resume, and ensure the overlay has 3:1 contrast for the action. Suggested focus token for the pause button border: #ffb86b on dark theme at 3px. sam_k: We'll add a11y E2E: tab to Pause, press Space to pause, confirm aria-live text contains "paused" and that SR stops reading chunks. Also add unit that asserts sr-buffer remains aria-hidden. access-bot: Extra suggestion: For very long responses, provide a "condensed summary" SR-only button which speaks a short summary of the response (aria-label: "Read summary"). Helpful for users who don't want full stream. ellie-ux: Love the summary idea as progressive enhancement. @sam_k can you take the Spike and draft the PR? Keep changes behind feature flag for experiments. sam_k: Yep, will spike and include test plan + telemetry to measure usage. frank-sre: We'll check server-side rates to ensure pausing doesn't leak connections. ellie-ux: Thanks team :thumbsup:
